privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We take your privacy seriously. This policy explains what data we collect and how we use it.
privacy.dataCollectionDescription: CrewOps does not collect personal data directly. The application may process operational data required for proper functioning.
privacy.cookiesDescription: This website uses only essential cookies required for the proper operation of the demo application. No tracking or marketing cookies are used.
privacy.dataUsageDescription: All collected data is used solely for application functionality and is not shared with third parties.
privacy.contactDescription: For questions regarding privacy, please contact Janusz Kuźnik via email.
